body: Accelerant announced expiration of its 40-day go-shop period and reaffirmed an all-cash sale to Thoma Bravo affiliates with an enterprise value above $4 billion.Key Highlights:Go-shop period expired Sep 22, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET after 40 days with no alternative acquisition proposals received.Affiliates of Thoma Bravo will acquire Accelerant in an all-cash transaction with enterprise value over $4 billion.Merger expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.Upon closing, Accelerant will become private and its common shares will no longer trade on the NYSE.Original SEC Filing: Accelerant Holdings [ ARX ] - 8-K - Sep. 23, 2026DisclaimerThis is an AI-powered summary.
